current_prompt.body:
READ the requirement to implement a comparison‑based sorting algorithm that must run in O(n) worst‑case time, be stable, and sort in‑place using O(1) extra space.
OUTPUT the algorithm design specifications adhering to those constraints.

current_plan.body:
REVIEW the requirement to implement a comparison‑based sorting algorithm with O(n) worst‑case time, stability, and in‑place O(1) extra space.
ANALYZE theoretical lower bounds for comparison‑based sorting and their implications for the stated constraints.
IDENTIFY any known algorithms or techniques that approach these constraints and assess their compliance.
EVALUATE whether a feasible design can satisfy all constraints simultaneously.
IF a feasible design exists THEN
DRAFT the algorithm design specifications covering the algorithmic approach, data structures, stability mechanisms, and in‑place operations.
ELSE
PREPARE a design specification that documents the constraint conflict, references the theoretical analysis, and proposes alternative viable approaches.
END IF
